attrs.summary: Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 is our flagship transcription and diarization model. It achieves SOTA transcription scores, outperforming Microsoft AI Transcribe 2, Whisper large-v3, GPT-Transcribe, Scribe v2, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. It also supports translation, speech Q&A, summarization, and function calling.
